# BE006 — Models require migrations (error)

Every app whose `models.py` defines a model class must ship a `migrations/` package with at least one migration file. Un-migrated models mean the code and the database schema have silently diverged — the next `migrate` on a fresh environment breaks.

```
apps/users/
├── models.py            # defines User
└── migrations/
    ├── __init__.py
    └── 0001_initial.py  # ✅ committed alongside the model
```

**Fix**: run `dude db makemigration --app <app>` (or `python manage.py makemigrations <app>`) and commit the generated file. Migrations are code — always committed, never regenerated on the fly in production.
